positions.title: Secretary
positions.description:
💜 Managed memberships, connected with recruiters, strategized fundraising, marketed club activities

positions.title: Robotics Coding Instructor
positions.description:
⚙️ Worked with 1st-4th grade classes at Challenger's after-school programs and summer camp

positions.title: WOW! That's Engineering Chair
positions.description:
💜 Collaborated with the SWE-SJSU board to coordinate our WOW! That’s Engineering event that exposed high school girls to opportunities in tech through hands-on workshops and talk panels
💜 Helped design program, designed the flyer, handled the Eventbrite registrations
💜 Gathered over 140 signups from local students

organizations.name: Society of Asian Scientists and Engineers (SASE)
Society of Women Engineers (SWE)
organizations.description:
- My role is to help organize our annual WOW! event. The goal of this event is to expose female high school students to the engineering field through hands-on workshops and talk panels from established engineers in the industry. 

- Attended SWE WE17 conference
